title: Keybind Profiles
description: Switch between multiple keybind profiles instantly with customizable hotkeys. Easily manage different controls for PvP, building, modpacks, or any playstyle.
body:
Keybind Profiles

Keybind Profiles is a lightweight NeoForge mod that allows you to instantly switch between multiple Minecraft keybind setups using customizable hotkeys.

Perfect for players who use different controls for PvP, building, modpacks, minigames, or different playstyles.

Features
Instantly switch between multiple keybind profiles
Automatically saves and loads controls
Fully customizable profile-switch hotkeys
Lightweight and easy to use
Profiles are stored locally as JSON files
Client-side only
Default Keys
Right Arrow → Next Profile
Left Arrow → Previous Profile

The hotkeys can be changed in the Minecraft Controls menu.

How It Works

Change your controls in Minecraft settings

Switch to another profile

Set different controls

Switch back anytime instantly

Each profile stores your complete Minecraft keybind configuration automatically.

Compatibility
Minecraft 26.1.2
NeoForge 26.1.2.64
Profile Storage

Profiles are automatically stored inside:

config/keybind_profiles/

Notes

This mod is completely client-side and does not need to be installed on servers.
